items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know; I don't remember that.

ctx.x: I don't know; I don't remember that.
He had trouble with it -- I'm sure it was asthma, yes, because Gladys used to have to work on him some nights. He used to have trouble with asthma. And that whiskey didn't do it any good, you know?

Lawrence told me the reason he happened to mentioned that was that, when he joined the band, there were 12 people here working, and Lawrence would have made 13, and Duke wouldn't let Lawrence play until Toby came back and made 14, because Duke didn't want 13 people in the band -- or at least, that was what he told Lawrence; he said it would be bad luck. Remember that? Lawrence said he went all the way across the country before he got to play; he said Duke wouldn't let him play until Toby came back, and so he…
